name: Deep Sky Blue
lede: Deep Sky Blue is a vivid, light azure from the X11 color list, with sky blue as its parent entry in Paterson.

sections.title: A listed color
sections.body:
Paterson's dictionary lists DeepSkyBlue as an entry in the X11 Color Set, with hex code 00BFFF, and sends the reader on to the entry for sky blue [1]. His index files it with the blues [2]. Our name records list CSS, a web encyclopedia and the xkcd list of 2010 [3].

The swatch is a screen color defined by its hex code 00BFFF: red at 0, green at 191, blue at 255 [5]. Against white it reaches 2.12:1 contrast [5].

Its nearest neighbors among our names, by CIELAB distance, are [[cyan-process|Cyan (Process)]], [[bright-sky-blue|Bright Sky Blue]] and [[united-nations-blue|United Nations Blue]] [5].

sections.title: Field notes
sections.body: No painting in our archive of 23,781 paintings has a color within CIEDE2000 4 of this swatch covering at least 1% of its canvas, as photographed [4]. That describes the archive, not painting as a whole, and it says nothing against the color: it is a screen color first, and museum photographs rarely hold it.
